known_nonblocking_notes: The verbal source bank provides explanation and shortcut fields but not structured distractor analysis for every option; Production v1.0 does not invent unsupported distractor explanations.
PDF export uses browser Print / Save as PDF for Arabic rendering and offline compatibility.
Training readiness is a workflow/progress indicator, not a psychometric composite score.
PQ10, Derailers and Leadership are used for training/self-development and are not normed employment-selection instruments.

The container environment blocks live localhost browser navigation; visual review uses Chromium rendering of representative production markup, while functional behavior is covered by regression tests.
